description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-SINGLE, SQL-AGG-TYPE: For the Currency groups of FC, what do Var, VarP, StDev and StDevP return (type, exact bits, or error and call), one statement per group (WHERE g = 1 to 12)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
